canonical_project: CipherTel Bunbury datacentre and managed backup facilities
notes: CipherTel's official site says the licensed Australian carrier is WA-owned and run from Bunbury, offering datacentre and backup services across multi-site Bunbury facilities; its business page specifically markets colocation and managed backup in Bunbury facilities. Business News separately describes CipherTel's head office, network exchange, data centre and NOC as located in Bunbury.
